pattern.description: The browser mockup is already zoomed in, and it glides up by about 9% of the frame height so the Options section sits mid-frame. At the same time the user opens the Start of plan date picker and starts typing '5/' into its search field.
pattern.why_premium: The reframe anticipates where the action goes next: the popup opens into space that the move has just cleared. The energy curve shows a quick start and a long smooth settle, so the shift reads as a deliberate eased follow rather than a page scroll.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.browser-mock', {yPercent: '-=9', duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}). Overlap it with the popup: tl.fromTo('.date-picker', {autoAlpha: 0, y: -4}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<0.1'), then type into the search with the TextPlugin ({text: '5/', duration: 0.3, ease: 'none'}).
build_hint.remotion: Run const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 140}}) and set translateY(interpolate(p,[0,1],[0,-0.086*height])) on the mock layer. Mount the popup at the click frame with a 4-frame opacity ramp, and type by slicing the string by frame.

notes: camera.move is 'none' (pan_y -0.086), so this is treated as the mock layer moving, not a camera move. It could also be read as a tilt-up on the zoomed screen recording. The popup may have opened just before the burst, since it is already partly visible at f2002. The cursor moves only with the layer and is not listed.
